children: MasTec pulled the plug on talks for a large acquisition in a push to prioritize stock buybacks.

The infrastructure engineering and construction company "is suspending late stage negotiations of a large potentially accretive acquisition opportunity in order to prioritize the repurchase of shares," it said Thursday.
MasTec said it has an existing authorization to buy back $250 million worth of shares, with the full amount remaining available.
Shares were down 7.7% at $154.75 as of midday Thursday, though they pared some earlier losses after the announcement. The stock is down 29% year to date.
